name: squeezebox
title: Squeezebox
description: A folk, trad and ceilidh band theme whose list of dates is an open melodeon bellows — each show a black cloth fold with the date and town in ivory capitals over a leaf-green paper fold edged in gold dots, nickel corners on every ridge — on an ivory ground that turns ebony after dark.

tokens.--font-display: grille capitals: band name, menu, dates, towns, status, ticket keys, labels and section headings
tokens.--font-body: body text, page titles, intro lines and the lines on the paper folds
tokens.--text-s: small print: menu, dates, status, ticket keys, footer labels
tokens.--text-l: intro lines, the band name in the header, occasion lines on the paper folds
tokens.--text-xl: town names on the cloth folds of the date list
tokens.--text-xxl: page titles and the show title on a show's own page
tokens.--leading-tight: line height of titles, town names and occasion lines
tokens.--tracking-caps: letter spacing of the grille capitals
tokens.--color-bg: page background: ivory celluloid by day, ebony in the dark scheme
tokens.--color-text: main text, the menu and the rule under table headings in page text
tokens.--color-muted: quieter text: intro lines, the empty-list line, blog dates
tokens.--color-accent: leaf green for links, the current menu item, tag outlines and the quote rule
tokens.--color-rule: thin rules under table rows and the menu's hover underline
tokens.--color-cloth: bellows cloth: the black folds, end frames, footer, the header's bottom rule, the dark stripes of the header mark and of the heading bar in page text, and the lettering on ticket keys and the sold-out stamp
tokens.--color-cloth-sheen: the light catching the top of each cloth fold
tokens.--color-cloth-ink: ivory capitals on the cloth folds, end frames and footer
tokens.--color-paper: bellows paper: the leaf-green folds of the date list, the green stripes of the header mark and of the heading bar in page text, and the left rule on blog list items
tokens.--color-paper-weave: the diamond print on the bellows paper
tokens.--color-gold: the gold dot border along each paper fold, the status underline and the footer labels
tokens.--color-nickel: nickel: the ridge corners, end-frame bands, the header's second rule and the lower edge of ticket keys
tokens.--color-nickel-shade: the shadowed side of the nickel corners and the outline of ticket keys
tokens.--color-key: ivory of the ticket keys and the sold-out stamp
tokens.--color-focus: the keyboard focus ring on the ivory ground
tokens.--color-focus-halo: the gap between a focused element and its ring
tokens.--color-code-bg: background of code in page text
tokens.--measure: maximum width of a text column
tokens.--date-col: width of the date column on the bellows folds on wide screens
tokens.--fold: how far each bellows fold tapers in at its ends
tokens.--corner: height of the nickel corner pieces
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of ticket keys, stamps, tags and code
tokens.--tap: minimum height of ticket keys and menu links
